consistency: Bounded value-only domain ring. Every recorded event snapshots domain charges at its actual emission boundary under the domain gate; later capture is not a cross-owner transaction. Sequence and monotonic-clock bounds are verified independently. Dropped events and sequence exhaustion are separately disclosed, never treated as complete history.
resetPolicy: One budget-domain lifetime; process metric reset does not reset domain events or ownership. Copy is non-consuming. Disabled tracing constructs no events; correctness counters remain enabled. Stale numeric events are not native-use authority.
identityPolicy: OwnerId is positive backing lineage or genuinely unavailable for ownerless admission. AllocationOrdinal identifies acquired backing when supplied; pre-acquisition absence is null, not fabricated zero. CorrelationId is event-specific owning control, descriptor, detach destination or generation. Generation zero is an actual identity, not unavailable.
units: RequestedBytes and PreviousBytes are kind-specific bytes, not RSS or invented hidden allocator overhead. CommittedBytes and ReservedBytes are domain gauges at emission. All twelve event fields are independently compared in each ordered-history proof.
overflow: Checked identities never wrap. Exhausted sequence stops recording and records actual loss; dropped histories saturate with their defined flag. Diagnostics cannot turn a successful storage transition into failure.
unreviewedScope: Complete definitions and actual ordered-history proofs for all 37 kinds do not certify every public API/lifecycle combination, generated schedule, feature benefit/counter cost, final native platform or shipping identity.

events.name: Admitted
events.definition: Complete backing extent reserved before acquisition; RequestedBytes is admitted extent, reserved gauge already includes it.
events.negative: Reuse/empty backing does not manufacture admission, and rejection never publishes it.

events.name: Allocated
events.definition: Actual fresh backing committed, exact extent and acquisition ordinal; reservation has moved to committed gauge.
events.negative: Backend failure emits no Allocated; backing retry does not invent a second acquisition.

events.name: Reallocated
events.definition: Actual backend realloc including from null; requested new extent, previous old extent, committed gauge is new storage charge and ordinal preserves lineage.
events.negative: Refused/failed growth does not report successful replacement or fabricated copied bytes.

events.name: Released
events.definition: Actual known backing physically freed; committed gauge already excludes it, acquired ordinal remains correlated.
events.negative: Logical return, retired backing and weak expiration are not physical free.

events.name: Rejected
events.definition: Minimum extent refused before backing acquisition or production; prior committed/pending charges survive. Ownerless application refusal has null identities.
events.negative: Native backend failure and invalid arguments are not budget rejection.

events.name: AcquisitionFailed
events.definition: Admitted ordinary backing failed and its prospective reservation was cancelled; prior committed storage remains until its real cleanup.
events.negative: No fabricated allocation/free event or OS guarantee.

events.name: PageAcquired
events.definition: One actual complete prepared page committed, with its page backing ordinal, not one allocation per slot.
events.negative: Prepared slot reuse and live-page trim do not emit acquisition.

events.name: Prepared
events.definition: Backing and metadata capacity preparation actually completed; requested extent is total prepared backing, no fabricated acquisition ordinal.
events.negative: Preparation failure does not report readiness; preparation is not another charge.

events.name: Trimmed
events.definition: Explicit maintenance physically freed complete idle backing; requested actual freed extent and its acquisition ordinal, committed charge already relieved.
events.negative: Live or borrowed storage preventing trim produces no invented relief.

events.name: Shared
events.definition: Actual initial or independent strong binding publication; requested complete backing, correlation is sharing control, not a second native allocation.
events.negative: Failed publication/strong-slot exhaustion does not publish another owner.

events.name: WeakCreated
events.definition: Actual independently releasable control-only weak observer; full extent describes observed payload, not a weak payload-retention obligation.
events.negative: Weak-slot exhaustion creates no observer; expired weak state cannot pin native payload.

events.name: WeakUpgraded
events.definition: Live weak observer acquired and published a real strong binding before returning it; sharing-control correlation and complete current backing.
events.negative: Full/expired refusal is not successful upgrade or resurrection.

events.name: UpgradeRejected
events.definition: Actual strong-slot exhaustion or expired payload refused weak upgrade. Requested backing is genuine current control extent, zero after actual payload return.
events.negative: No acquired strong binding; weak observation alone remains control-only.

events.name: OwnershipReleased
events.definition: One actual strong/weak binding released; correlation sharing control and requested current backing, zero after payload already returned.
events.negative: Stale/double release fails rather than decrementing twice or manufacturing a free.

events.name: PayloadReturned
events.definition: Last strong binding and entered read ended and actual payload return completed; requested prior complete extent while committed gauge reflects real physical/reusable storage.
events.negative: Lingering weak control has no payload-retention right; failed return is not success.

events.name: Detached
events.definition: Explicit independent copy publication. Layout requests copied field bytes and correlates destination control; shared detach requests complete retained source backing and correlates sharing control. Both are documented, not a uniform copied-byte measurement.
events.negative: Failed publication may count actual copied bytes but never successful detach ownership.

events.name: UniqueReturned
events.definition: Actual unique payload obligation ended, requested complete backing; physical free is separate, pooled capacity may remain charged/reusable.
events.negative: Moved-from/stale aliases cannot free destination; entered borrow may defer actual return.

events.name: Moved
events.definition: Destructive unique authority movement actually published next checked version; unchanged full backing, lineage and control correlation.
events.negative: Entered operation/exhaustion consumption is not successful movement.

events.name: Retired
events.definition: Consumed unique ownership awaits last actual borrow or cleanup retry; full still-charged extent and original control correlation.
events.negative: Retirement is not a new allocation, authority restoration or physical release.

events.name: ReservationAdmitted
events.definition: Actual producer control/metadata and complete pending extent admitted before production; owner/control identity is real, backing ordinal absent until acquired.
events.negative: Byte refusal or metadata preparation failure creates no published permission/charge.

events.name: ReservationPreparationFailed
events.definition: Prospective control preparation actually failed before admission; requested prospective extent, null owner/correlation and unchanged charges.
events.negative: No invented control identity, successful reservation or backing failure.

events.name: ReservationBackingPrepared
events.definition: Actual pending charge became prepared unpublished backing; requested exact extent, acquired ordinal if nonempty, same permission control.
events.negative: Retry over already acquired backing cannot invent acquisition or another prepared charge.

events.name: ReservationBackingFailed
events.definition: Actual preparation failed while producer permission survives, retaining pending or genuinely acquired prepared charge; ordinal absent before acquisition.
events.negative: Failure is not ordinary byte-capacity refusal or permission cancellation.

events.name: ReservationMoved
events.definition: Producer permission moved to next checked version without a second control/charge; requested complete extent, original control correlation.
events.negative: Checked authority exhaustion consumes cleanup without wrapping or publishing movement.

events.name: ReservationActivated
events.definition: Complete initialization published unique ownership over the same control; pending/prepared producer obligation ended, native backing charge survives.
events.negative: Incomplete/cancelled initialization never publishes unique authority.

events.name: ReservationReturned
events.definition: Consumed producer permission completed actual terminal resource return for non-cancel/abandon/exhaustion outcomes; requested declared extent and acquired ordinal if any.
events.negative: Failed resource return remains charged until genuine successful retry.

events.name: ReservationCancelled
events.definition: Explicit cancellation/disposal completed pending/prepared terminal return; exact reserved/committed relief and same control identity.
events.negative: Returning permission does not fabricate physical free for never-acquired backing.

events.name: ReservationInitializationFailed
events.definition: Entered producer actually failed or left incomplete output; backing stays charged until subsequent cleanup. Requested declared extent and same control.
events.negative: Backend failure before producer or cancellation after complete writes is not initialization failure.

events.name: ReservationAbandoned
events.definition: Emergency finalization completed an abandoned pending/prepared resource obligation; declared extent, no ordinal/free if backing was never acquired.
events.negative: Fallback is not timely admission relief or guaranteed scheduling.

events.name: ReservationReturnFailed
events.definition: Actual resource-return attempt failed; original extent/control and still-charged pending/prepared state, no success credit.
events.negative: Failure does not revive consumed producer authority or fabricate release.

events.name: ReservationAuthorityExhausted
events.definition: Checked producer authority exhaustion consumed source and actually completed terminal return; unchanged non-wrapping identity, no successful move.
events.negative: No wrapping version, restored authority or fabricated backing event.

events.name: LayoutPrepared
events.definition: Actual acquired backing alignment prepared; requested payload extent including field padding but excluding base slack, descriptor correlation and acquired backing ordinal.
events.negative: Acquired backing before failed observation need not yet have prepared layout alignment.

events.name: LayoutInitialized
events.definition: Every typed region and non-payload range completed initialization; requested typed logical bytes only, descriptor correlation. Later cancellation can still prevent publication.
events.negative: Incomplete regions emit no success and become no unique ownership.

events.name: GenerationDetached
events.definition: Deterministic owner relinquished ended generation to emergency cleanup; full actual still-owned extent remains charged and actual generation, including zero, is correlation.
events.negative: Detach is neither a second extent nor physical/native release.

events.name: GenerationRetired
events.definition: Ended generation held for entered operation/control; requested actual owned retained extent, no backing ordinal, actual generation correlation.
events.negative: Rejoin can complete zero-extent generation cleanup with backing still charged elsewhere.

events.name: GenerationQuarantined
events.definition: Failed cleanup removed ended generation from every reusable bank; actual owned extent stays charged, actual generation correlation.
events.negative: Quarantine does not imply current generation quarantined or provide free/reuse credit.

events.name: GenerationReleased
events.definition: Generation cleanup actually completed. Requested remaining owned extent can be genuine zero after transfer or independent segment finalization; domain gauge is actual backing state, generation zero is real.
events.negative: No invented physical free; every known backing release remains separately correlated and charged until actual cleanup.
